messages:
sara_support: FYI customer (ACME) says responses got 'blunter' and shorter after the recent model bump to redwood-2.4f. Posting repro + diffs.
sara_support: Customer prompt: \"Summarize the team update and highlight risks for the execs.\"
---
Before (redwood-2.3): \"Summary: The team delivered the milestone on time with two minor risks: A) onboarding delays for new hires, B) flaky integration tests. Recommend weekly syncs and a focused QA sprint.\"
After (redwood-2.4f): \"Summary: Milestone done. Risks: onboarding, tests. Do QA sprint.\"
---
sara_support: They say subtle phrasing/verbosity loss started immediately after the rollout at ~2025-11-03T12:05Z. No other config changes on their side.
leo_engineering: Can you paste the exact API request they used (headers + body) and a trace id if available? Also which model alias did they call (redwood-2.4f vs redwood-2.4f-opt)?
sara_support: Here is what they sent:
```
POST /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
X-Redwood-Trace: rwd-trace-9a3b
{
  "model": "redwood-2.4f",
  "input": "Summarize the team update and highlight risks for the execs.",
  "max_tokens": 160,
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "top_p": 0.95
}
```
leo_engineering: Good, trace id noted. Mina or infra, can we pull the server-side sampling params for that trace and the model variant served? Also check if the rollout toggled any decoding defaults (top_k/top_p/temperature clamp) at 12:05Z.
mina_research: I pulled the traces for rwd-trace-9a3b. Model shard served: redwood-2.4f-20251101 (variant: default-decoder). Sampling params in gateway: temperature=0.2, top_p=0.95, top_k unset. Runtime patch at 2025-11-03T12:04:50Z toggled \"instruction_truncation=true\" for some canary hosts to fix a memory edge-case. That could remove some system/context tokens prior to decoding.
leo_engineering: Interesting. If instruction_truncation dropped or folded the system prompt, the model might receive a shorter instruction/context, leading to terser outputs. Any evidence of dropped system tokens for that trace?
mina_research: For rwd-trace-9a3b the request arrived with system prompt length 256 tokens; after gateway processing the assistant saw ~198 tokens. I can share a redacted diff but customer data needs masking. It looks like the truncation heuristic clipped trailing system guidance in 12% of cases for long contexts.
sara_support: Customer insists they didn't change their system prompt. We should explain what's happening and propose mitigation.
james_product: Prioritize mitigation: either roll back the canary toggle, or implement a fallback to preserve full system prompts for requests that appear to be instruction-sensitive. Also we should provide the customer a repro they can run locally.
leo_engineering: Short-term: set a runtime flag to disable instruction_truncation for their tenant. Long-term: adjust truncation to preserve the last N tokens of system prompt that contain punctuation or newlines (likely to hold instructions).
leo_engineering: @sara_support can you offer this to the customer: a temporary per-tenant override + request we run a replay with full context? Also ask them for a small prompt set (3-5 examples) where they see the worst regressions.
sara_support: Yes, I'll offer the per-tenant override and ask for examples. I'll also provide a repro curl they can use to confirm before/after. Sharing repro to send them now:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Trace: rwd-repro-123\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2.4f","input":"Summarize the team update and highlight risks for the execs.","max_tokens":160,"temperature":0.2,"top_p":0.95}'
```
deploy-bot: Canary toggle \"instruction_truncation\" was enabled 2025-11-03T12:04:50Z by deploy/user_maya. Rollout: canary 10% -> scheduled ramp.
mina_research: Recommendation: patch gateway to prefer preserving system prompt suffix when truncation is required (heuristic: keep last 64 tokens if system contains keywords like \"instructions\", \"assistant\", \"you are\" ). I'll open a PR and add regression E2E tests using customer-supplied examples.
sara_support: Customer ok with a temporary override. They supplied 4 examples and gave permission to replay them against full context. I'll schedule replay and send confirmation when done.
leo_engineering: Thanks team. After replay, please paste before/after outputs in this thread (redact PII). Also attach the tenant override id so infra can verify.
sara_support: Will do. Keeping thread open until we have before/after and the infra override id.:thumbsup:
